query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND message LIKE "*pam_unix(sshd:session)*"
        AND (message LIKE "*session opened*" OR message LIKE "*session closed*")
| EVAL session_action = CASE(message LIKE "*session opened*", "opened", message LIKE "*session closed*", "closed", "other")
| EVAL session_user = CASE(message LIKE "*for user svc.deploy*", "svc.deploy", message LIKE "*for user svc.config-mgmt*", "svc.config-mgmt", message LIKE "*for user dev.dana*", "dev.dana", "other")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, session_action, session_user, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC
